First release of releasedrift.

It reads a source tree and finds every file you download from GitHub releases: `releases/download` URLs, `releases/latest` URLs and `gh release download` in Dockerfiles, shell scripts, Makefiles, GitHub Actions workflows and Ansible. For each one it tells you whether a SHA-256 is checked next to the download, asks the GitHub API whether the release is immutable, and compares your pinned hash with the digest GitHub reports. It keeps those digests in a state file, so the next run tells you if a release file was replaced.

It only reads. It never downloads release files, never changes your files, and works without a GitHub token.

Binaries below are static builds for Linux and macOS (amd64 and arm64). Check them against checksums.txt. You can also install from source:

    go install github.com/sudodrift/releasedrift/cmd/releasedrift@v0.1.0
